title: MSM Sexual Health Study
summary:
This online study investigates sexual health among men who have sex with men (MSM), with a particular focus on chemsex – sexual activity under the influence of certain psychoactive substances. The aim is to better understand how chemsex affects sexuality, mental health, well-being, and the use of support services. MSM with and without chemsex experience will be asked about various topics, such as sexual experiences, substance use, intraminority stress, and possible sexual dysfunctions. Participation is anonymous and takes about 30 minutes.
A subset of participants will be invited to complete a follow-up survey after 12 months to assess changes in substance use, sexuality, and well-being over time. The findings will help to develop targeted support services grounded in sexual therapy and addiction medicine.
